questions.stem: What does the 'width' of a product mix refer to?

options.text: The total number of products in a mix.
The number of different product lines.
The market share of the products.

questions.explanation: The width of a product mix refers to the number of different product lines a company offers. This helps in understanding the variety in the product offerings.

distractorRationale.a: Option a is incorrect because it describes length, not width.
distractorRationale.b: Option c describes depth, which is different from width.
distractorRationale.c: Option d is unrelated to product mix dimensions.

questions.stem: What is an example of individual branding?
questions.explanation: Individual branding occurs when a company markets each product under a unique brand name, such as Star Lager by Nigerian Breweries.
